**Main line:** Ke4 e6 Kxf5 (Black wins the rook and both pawns, with an overwhelming material advantage)

**Motif:** hangingPiece, attraction

**Coaching Note:**
Don't miss quiet moves that win material! Your king on f3 was perfectly placed to attack the rook. When you push forward to e4, your king forks the rook and both pawns—the rook can't be defended. In rook endgames, an active king wins games. Always check if a king advance threatens undefended pieces before playing a check.
